values: Scope: submit-triggered behavior only for Initial Form, HTML/REST Progressive Form, and Schedule Appointment Form. Includes positive, negative, partial-success, duplicate, and risk cases; excludes pre-submit rendering, validation, prefill, filtering, and calendar display.

QA setup: replace placeholder contacts/opportunities/users/calendars with disposable test records. Record actual IDs and environment details in Notes or Evidence Link. Verify both intended effects and stated non-effects after every submission.
GHL connection, pipeline, default routing, state-to-user mapping, user-to-stage mapping, redirect URL, and relevant custom fields are configured.
Valid email and phone; state with an assigned user; first/last name, role, interest, event address/date, company, and message populated.
Submission succeeds and redirects with contact_id and opportunity_id query parameters.
Contact is upserted; assignedTo matches the state-routed user; tags contain lead and '<assigned user first name> lead'; standard fields and resolvable contact custom fields are saved.
